notes.content:

notes.title: Version 1.01 Release
notes.content:
Hello, unwavering chevaliers!

After several smaller updates I can now present version 1.01 of Unterholz! Along with numerous tweaks and fixes, this version also brings a few new features and improvements to the gameplay. 

[list]
[*][b]Realistic or Cinematic Combat Sounds[/b]

As already announced previously, you can now choose between cinematic combat sounds and a more realistic approach. I have kept the cinematic sounds from the original as the default, as these sounds offer good feedback during battles and are more akin contemporary Hollywood movie productions. However, if you have ever witnessed an authentic, historically more accurate fight of two knights in armour with longswords, you will undoubtedly be familiar with the tinny staccato of forged metal against full plate.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147124/90bfb82c2eb5fa7aaca60cd840fd4f1aadcefd46.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]New Dynamic Icon System[/b]

Furthermore, you will now be able to spot interactable objects such as items, points of interest and characters easier with the introduction of a more convenient dynamic icon system. Approaching items from a distance will now place a dot icon above every interactable that can be seen from afar. Never miss a part of the lore or collectible item again!
[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Updated Soundtrack[/b]

In addition to this I have updated the MP3 soundtrack in the game folder with ID3-tagged versions of the tracks and included the official front and rear sleeve artworks in the archive.
[/list]

[list]
[*]
[b]Many Fixes and Improvements[/b]

A lot of minor tweaks, fixes and optimisations have been done to further enhance your experience and hopefully smash any lingering bugs from development - except for those that crawl out of the underbrush of course to infest your shiny armour, remove them by repeatedly pressing "E"...!
[/list]

Thanks to all the chevaliers who played the game, recorded and shared videos and gave valuable feedback! I hope you are having fun exploring this tiny cozy copse and enjoy the atmosphere and lore.

As usual, your savegames will be compatible as well. A more detailed changelog can be found here:

[b]1.01d Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Added option to toggle cinematic or realistic impacts (new feature)
[*] Added distant dynamic hint system to interactable objects (new feature)
[*] Targets can now be unlocked once locked via the" lock on" key/button
[*] Targeting will now automatically unlock when sheathing the weapon
[*] Updated MP3 soundtrack archive to show proper ID3 tags and include additional album cover artwork (free)
[*] Wolf sign not hidden in the beginning of the game anymore
[*] Foliage and landscape fixes
[*] Added more destructible crates and barrels
[*] Added a few more chests
[*] Added key/button configuration for zoom/inspect which can be activated via "Y"/"Z" or "Left Trigger" or configured freely
[*] Added key/button configuration for inventory which can now be opened via "Tab", "I", "Select" or configured freely
[*] Changed item description of "Crude Powder" to "Bone Marrow"
[*] Fixed sheathing/equipping sword during flashback
[*] Set keyboard to default input device when starting the game
[*] Updated village signpost to always show interaction
[*] Added various hints to the hint system
[*] Minor fixes
[*] Additional performance optimisations
[/list]

Kind regards,
The Last Pilot

notes.title: Version 1.01 Preview
notes.content:
Hello, steadfast chevaliers!

The next update will bring Unterholz to [b]version 1.01[/b] and include a range of fixes, changes and new features! I would like to give you an additional [b]preview[/b] of what will be included:

[list]
[*] Better indication of interactable objects in the game:
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147124/4e75d29e1677207ea5c34c6930a99f86c2772050.png[/img]

A dot will indicate an interactable object or character from greater distance. Approaching the location will change the dot into the interactable icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147124/25fbd277d7567a70c6070c0affa33cb4ab8abda5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Additional hints to improve overall communication of gameplay elements and puzzles:
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147124/82c91e56908efc6df8a0878f434517af273b16a2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] A new gameplay option to toggle between the original as well as realistic armour and weapon impact sounds.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Edited soundtrack including proper ID3 tags and a front as well as a rear cover, included with the game in the "Soundtrack" folder. In addition to this, the soundtrack will be released as an official Steam Soundtrack, including high quality FLAC audio as well. This soundtrack is the same that is already included with the game and will come completely [b]free [/b] as a bundle with the original game. You can then download or listen to it via the official Steam Soundtracks feature and it will appear in your library neat and tidy with its own sleeve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147124/a4bf77a92f3f24456dc71163695e2fd7e22d6cf0.png[/img]

Many excellent gameplay videos of Unterholz helped me in finding a lot of the remaining bugs and provided valuable feedback during the development. Thanks go out to all the creators and viewers who contributed, shared and commented - it's amazing to see you play and analyse the game and its secrets!  

I am currently working on implementing the final touches, the patch as well as the updated soundtrack should be available in the next few days!

Kind regards,
The Last Pilot

Kind regards,

notes.title: Patch 1.00i - Release Notes for 20/11/2024
notes.content:
Hello, trusty chevaliers!

With patch 1.00i I am addressing several issues I have gathered from the various gameplay videos and let's plays I found for Unterholz. Thanks go out to everyone playing the game, making videos and sharing their experience. More are still about to come as I approach version 1.01. As always the new version is fully compatible with your savegames.

-> As of now it could happen, that the ghostly lady does not appear right away after having charged the crystal (completing the alchemistic process). If that happens you can save and reload to make her appear. There will be no progress lost except for the collected score of items. I am currently working on a fix for that as well.

1.00i
- Fixed an issue with broken barrels
- Prevented sword from disappearing during the vermin attack
- Several landscape corrections
- Placed a few more treasure objects for additional score points across the copse
- Fixed the prompt for the ghostly lady
- Additional fix to make sure that the smuggler appears in the cave after charging the crystal
- Prevented faux pressure plates from counting towards the puzzle solution in the final area of the game (only a few specific plates need to be triggered, the clues to find out which are all in the game)
- Inventory will now only open when not viewing the map or selecting a travel destination


Kind regards,

The Last Pilot

notes.title: Patch 1.00h with additional changes and fixes!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurous chevaliers! 

The latest patch 1.00h has been added to the default branch. As always it is fully compatible with your savegames.

I have also identified an issue with the sword disappearing during the insect attack event that occurs when you are getting crawled by several bugs (no pun intended) and have to press E (keyboard) or X (controller) to get rid of them. I am hard at work on a fix for this, together with a few other quality of life features I want to get out. As of now, the sword will reappear once you save and load or respawn (no progress will be lost, no matter where you currently are in the game). This issue will be resolved in an upcoming update.

The various gameplay videos all over Youtube help a great deal in identifying things like this, thanks to all the players! 

Relase Notes:

- Moved toy to chest in room with mascaron
- Added a few more subtle hints
- Fixed display of several hints and tutorials
- Fixed overlapping of diary monologues
- Removed redundant key bindings

Kind regards,

notes.title: Patch 1.00d - Release Notes for 12/11/2024
notes.content:
Version 1.00d is an initial attempt to improve overall performance via several tweaks to the game:

- initial performance optimisations (including altered tree LODs, optimised cascaded shadows, optimised lighting)

Additional tweaks will be implemented as I figure out what options I still have to streamline the engine, assets and code.

Update: An additional performance patch is already underway and will be released as soon as possible, looks like I found one of the main culprits in regards to a high-poly model that received no distance culling at all.
